name: Tarnic Yarrith
keeps: the weights, and the habit of checking them
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: Accused of raising the storm that struck James VI’s ship.
text: Tarnic yarrith of the thin wall, keeps a door for the 11th tranche, doors 96 to 104. Keeps the weights, and the habit of checking them. Reads John Fian.
